data.long_meaning: Preyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Prajapati', which refers to the Creator God of the universe in Hindu mythology. In Hindu tradition, Prajapati is the lord of all beings and the creator of the universe. Therefore, Preyansh is a name that symbolizes power, creation, and the divine. The name Preyansh carries the meaning “Lord of Creatures” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Preyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of creatures and live with faith, good character and purpose.
